summary: Launching the ui-root-harness-ts storybook:dev task through owned-command changed cwd to the checkout root at reexec and command spawn. Storybook's -c storybook then resolved to gamezilla/storybook instead of pkgs/ui-root-harness-ts/storybook and failed MainFileMissingError.
